reason: A dsh integration plugin that configures, hot-switches, and observes HTTP proxy routing for the host application's LLM requests, with status and connectivity-test endpoints.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 的 LLM 请求配置并动态切换 HTTP(S) 代理路由，并提供状态查看与连通性测试接口。
summaries.en: Configures and hot-switches HTTP(S) proxy routing for dsh LLM requests and provides status and connectivity-testing endpoints.

capabilities: Routes the host application's LLM HTTP requests through a configured HTTP(S) proxy
Changes the global undici dispatcher and restores the baseline dispatcher when disabled
Reads proxy settings and environment variables
Exposes status and connectivity-test HTTP endpoints
